paper_goal_alignment.reason: The design tests whether a widely available objective closed-issue duration metric can support bounded inference about OSS maintenance timeliness when unresolved backlog evidence and observable project context are retained.

research_scope.formal_entity: OSS software project represented by a prospectively curated canonical GitHub repository
research_scope.robustness_window: 2023-01 through 2025-12 (36 months) only if post-curation and variable coverage remain adequate
research_scope.construct_boundary: bounded operational-performance subdomain only; not overall OSS project performance, productivity, resource efficiency, broad effectiveness, software quality, popularity, community health, or human-only team performance

narrow_research_question.RQ: To what extent does a closed-issue resolution-duration metric provide consistent project-month evidence about OSS maintenance timeliness when unresolved backlog age and backlog burden are retained, and how sensitive are these measures to observable workload and participation/change context?

implementation_semantics: Issue lifecycle grouped by issue number.
last_action is derived from opened/closed/reopened actions.
closed_at is the latest close event.
only issues whose last_action is closed enter the duration distribution.
metric exposes average, quantiles, and threshold-level counts.
issue_resolution_duration.validity_consequence: Closed-only duration is conditional on completion and omits unresolved issues. It is therefore a candidate timeliness indicator under test, not a complete project-level timeliness measure.

issue_age.semantics: Age of issues remaining open at the considered time; reopened issues are treated as open since initial opening under the documented metric semantics.
issue_age.implementation_semantics: For each evaluation time, computes duration from opened_at for issues open at that time and exposes average, quantiles, and age-level counts.
issue_age.validity_role: Complementary risk-set/backlog evidence required to avoid interpreting closed-only duration in isolation.

reason: It is primarily community/process responsiveness rather than core project performance.
OpenDigger implementation substitutes first response with opened_at + 15 days when no qualifying response is observed, which changes the raw event semantics.

change_request_resolution_duration.reason: OpenDigger implementation closes PullRequestEvent lifecycles without a primary distinction between merged success and closed-unmerged non-integration in the generic resolution-duration metric; it is not authorized as successful integration timeliness.

primary_candidate_under_test.field: quantile_2 (0.50 quantile) where source version confirms current quantile ordering
primary_candidate_under_test.meaning: typical elapsed platform-recorded time from issue opening to latest/final close among issues included in the closed-only monthly metric
primary_candidate_under_test.key_failure_mode: conditioning on completed items can hide unresolved backlog

complementary_unresolved_evidence.field: quantile_2 conditional on at least one open issue
complementary_unresolved_evidence.meaning: typical age of unresolved issues at month-end
complementary_unresolved_evidence.zero_rule: If no open issues exist, age is undefined, not zero; backlog-presence/burden must carry that state.

complementary_unresolved_evidence.derivation: sum age-level counts at month-end, after source-version semantics are verified
complementary_unresolved_evidence.direction: not a performance score by itself; contextual/complementary evidence
complementary_unresolved_evidence.zero_rule: Observed zero open issues may be coded zero only when repository/source observability for that month is verified.

contextual_covariates.meaning: incoming observable issue volume / workload-context proxy
contextual_covariates.not_meaning: not project demand in full and not performance
not formal team size, labor hours, effort, or productivity input
not productivity, effort, complexity, or quality

excluded_from_core.accepted_pull_requests: completed integration output/activity; not performance without additional argument
excluded_from_core.issue_closed_counts: throughput trace, not performance by itself
excluded_from_core.response_time: community/process responsiveness and source imputation semantics
excluded_from_core.technical_quality: no currently frozen cross-project defect/quality semantics

panel_models.principle: Associational measurement-validation regressions; no causal interpretation.

model_A_concordance_age.equation: ln1p(open_issue_age_median_it) = beta1*ln1p(closed_issue_resolution_median_it) + beta2*ln1p(issues_new_it) + beta3*ln1p(contributors_it) + beta4*ln1p(code_change_lines_it) + project_FE + month_FE + error_it
model_A_concordance_age.sample: project-months with at least one open issue and a defined closed-issue resolution median
model_A_concordance_age.estimand: within-project association between completed-item timeliness and unresolved-backlog age after observable context controls
model_A_concordance_age.interpretation: positive concordance is evidence that the two traces move consistently; weak/negative/context-sensitive association indicates an inferential boundary. It does not prove construct validity.

model_B_concordance_burden.equation: asinh(open_issue_backlog_count_it) = beta1*ln1p(closed_issue_resolution_median_it) + beta2*ln1p(issues_new_it) + beta3*ln1p(contributors_it) + beta4*ln1p(code_change_lines_it) + project_FE + month_FE + error_it
model_B_concordance_burden.sample: observable project-months with defined closed-issue resolution median
model_B_concordance_burden.estimand: within-project association between closed-item duration and unresolved backlog burden
model_B_concordance_burden.interpretation: used to test whether apparently faster completed-item resolution coexists with accumulating unresolved work.

model_C_context_sensitivity_closed_durat.equation: ln1p(closed_issue_resolution_median_it) = theta1*ln1p(issues_new_it) + theta2*ln1p(contributors_it) + theta3*ln1p(code_change_lines_it) + project_FE + month_FE + error_it
model_C_context_sensitivity_closed_durat.estimand: context sensitivity of the candidate closed-only timeliness metric
model_C_context_sensitivity_closed_durat.interpretation: coefficients describe association/context dependence, not causal effects.

model_D_context_sensitivity_open_age.equation: ln1p(open_issue_age_median_it) = theta1*ln1p(issues_new_it) + theta2*ln1p(contributors_it) + theta3*ln1p(code_change_lines_it) + project_FE + month_FE + error_it
model_D_context_sensitivity_open_age.interpretation: compare pattern with Model C rather than treating either coefficient vector as causal.

stata_baseline: xtreg ln_age ln_resolution ln_issues_new ln_contributors ln_code_lines i.month_id, fe vce(cluster project_id)
xtreg asinh_backlog ln_resolution ln_issues_new ln_contributors ln_code_lines i.month_id, fe vce(cluster project_id)
xtreg ln_resolution ln_issues_new ln_contributors ln_code_lines i.month_id, fe vce(cluster project_id)
robustness_not_yet_executed: use OpenDigger avg instead of median only as a reasonable definition sensitivity check
lag context covariates by one month as a temporal-sensitivity check without causal relabeling
winsorization only if prospectively justified by data-error/outlier diagnostics; never for significance seeking
alternative project curation rules frozen before outcome inspection

missingness_and_zero_rules.count_sparse_key: Within verified source observability, an omitted monthly count key may be structural zero under OpenDigger sparse-count semantics.
missingness_and_zero_rules.resolution_duration_missing: No defined closed-item duration in a month is missing/not-estimable for that metric-month, never zero performance.
missingness_and_zero_rules.age_no_open_items: Median age is undefined when backlog count is zero; preserve backlog_count=0 separately.
missingness_and_zero_rules.repository_not_yet_exposed_or_no_longer_: outside exposure window / missing, never zero

sample_rules.next_sample_gate: R3 must audit issue_age and exact field coverage and apply outcome-blind project curation before any metric values are analyzed.

claims_authorized_after_R2: Closed-only issue resolution duration is a candidate measure of completed-item timeliness with a known selection/incompleteness boundary.
Open-issue age and backlog burden provide complementary evidence about unresolved work.
Objective repository metrics should be interpreted jointly and conditionally rather than equated with overall project performance.
claims_not_authorized: The metric is a validated measure of overall OSS project performance.
Faster issue closure causes higher project performance.
Contributor count measures team size or effort.
Code-change lines measure productivity or complexity.
No open issues or no closed issues imply zero performance.

next_stage.title: Outcome-Blind Project Curation + Exact Variable Coverage Gate
tasks: Apply prospective project/software/canonical-repository curation to the 935 full-24-month GitHub candidates without reading metric values.
Audit file/field/month coverage for issue_age plus the frozen R2 variables.

Estimate post-curation N and complete-case/usable project-month NT under each R2 model without examining outcome magnitudes.
